senses.gloss:
Sindhu
------------------------------------------
The name of the river सिन्धु (the modern Indus river) appears many times in the Ṛgveda. According to the पुराणस् it is a branch of the heavenly river गङ्गा. When गङ्गा fell into the lake बिन्दु from हेअवेन्, it broke into seven branches, one of which was सिन्धु, which flowed towards the west. A bath in this river was supposed to take one to हेअवेन्.
Sindhu was also the name of a country. Jayadratha was its king during the period of the Mahābhārata.
The country of सिन्धु was famous for its robust and fine horses.
Sindhu also means the sea.
